name: Phantom 4
benefits: Plush ZipFoam ride at a 35mm stack for cushioned daily miles
Roomy toe box with APMA Seal of Acceptance
Doubles as an all-day walking and standing shoe
description: Topo's high-cushion neutral daily trainer for running, walking, and all-day wear.
skipIf: you want a fast, snappy tempo shoe — this is built for comfort, not speed.

name: Ultrafly 6
benefits: Light stability from a medial post that wraps the heel
High cushioning in a stable, structured daily trainer
APMA-accepted with Topo's roomy anatomical fit
description: A cushioned stability daily trainer that guides mild overpronation without feeling controlling.
skipIf: you're a strictly neutral runner — the medial support is there whether you need it or not.

name: Atmos 2
benefits: Topo's tallest road stack (40mm) for maximum cushioning
Upgraded ZipFoam keeps the big stack lively, not mushy
APMA-accepted, with wide sizes available
description: Topo's max-cushion neutral road cruiser for long, easy miles and all-day comfort.
skipIf: you like feeling the ground — this is the tallest, softest shoe Topo makes.

name: Aura 2
benefits: Y-Frame Guidance System stabilizes without a rigid post
Max cushioning at a 38mm stack for long days on feet
Roomy toe box with wide sizes available
description: Topo's max-cushion stability shoe pairing plush foam with gentle guidance.
skipIf: weight matters to you — at 10.6 oz it's one of Topo's heaviest road shoes.

name: Specter 3
benefits: RevFoam ATPU midsole for serious energy return
Just 7.7 oz despite a 39mm max stack
Redesigned rocker geometry for fast transitions
description: A max-cushion, plateless Pro Series performance trainer for up-tempo days and long racing.
skipIf: you want one shoe for everything — this is a speed-day tool, not an everyday walker.

name: Specter Elite
benefits: Topo's first carbon-plated race shoe
Ultralight RevFoam plus aggressive rocker for race pace
Race-day propulsion with a toe box your toes can actually splay in
description: Topo's flagship carbon-plated racer built for PR attempts from 5K to marathon.
skipIf: you need a durable daily trainer — at $250 this is a race-day-only shoe.

name: Cyclone 3
benefits: Pebax-powered midsole for a springy, fast ride
Only 6.9 oz — Topo's lightest cushioned speed shoe
Lower stack keeps it agile for intervals and racing
description: A featherweight plateless speed trainer for tempo runs, intervals, and racing.
skipIf: you want plush protection for long miles — this rides low and firm by design.

name: Magnifly 6
benefits: Zero drop with a real 26mm cushion stack — natural mechanics without punishment
New softer, lighter ZipFoam midsole
Ideal bridge shoe for runners moving toward zero drop
description: Topo's cushioned zero-drop road trainer for daily running and walking.
skipIf: your calves and Achilles aren't ready for zero drop — transition gradually.

name: Fli-Lyte 6
benefits: One shoe for runs, lifting, and cross-training
Low 3mm drop with grounded, stable feel
APMA-accepted lightweight trainer at 7.8 oz
description: A lightweight low-drop crossover trainer for running, gym work, and everyday wear.
skipIf: you want cushioning for long road miles — the low stack runs firm past 10K.

name: ST-6
benefits: Near-barefoot 14mm stack and zero drop for maximum ground feel
6.6 oz — disappears on your foot
Great for form work, strength training, and short natural runs
description: Topo's minimal zero-drop road shoe for barefoot-style running and gym sessions.
skipIf: you're not already adapted to minimal shoes — there's almost no cushioning here.

name: Revive
benefits: 3D Wave Sense insole massages tired feet with every step
Cozy fleece slip-on, backless for effortless on/off
Ounce-and-a-half lighter than the Rekovr 2
description: A backless fleece recovery slipper-shoe for post-run rest days and around the house.
skipIf: you'll wear it outdoors a lot — the open heel and fleece upper favor indoor lounging.

name: Rekovr 2
benefits: 3D Wave Sense footbed stimulates and massages the foot
Antimicrobial wool upper resists odor and stays warm
Full heel and Vibram outsole make it errand-capable
description: A slip-on active-recovery shoe with a massaging footbed and wool upper for after-workout wear.
skipIf: you want an open, airy recovery slide — the wool upper runs warm in summer.

name: Ultraventure 5
benefits: Topo's flagship cushioned trail shoe for ultra distances
Vibram XS Trek outsole grips road-to-trail terrain
New universal gaiter system and more durable upper
description: A high-cushion neutral trail workhorse for long runs, ultras, and cushioned hiking.
skipIf: you run truly technical, rocky terrain — no rock plate and a taller stack trade precision for plush.

name: MTN Racer 4
benefits: Vibram Megagrip bites into technical terrain
Race-day responsiveness that still handles daily training
FKT insole drains fast after creek crossings
description: A performance trail runner for racing and fast training on rugged, technical trails.
skipIf: most of your miles are smooth fire roads — the aggressive grip is overkill there.

name: Vista
benefits: Topo's tallest trail stack (38mm) of max cushion
Vibram Megagrip with 4mm lugs for real traction
Quick-draining FKT insole for wet conditions
description: Topo's max-cushion trail runner for eating up long miles on varied terrain.
skipIf: you want nimble ground feel on technical ridgelines — this is a tall, plush cruiser.

name: Terraventure 5
benefits: Flexible ESS rock plate shields feet from sharp terrain
Vibram Megagrip plus a low 3mm drop for connected control
Built-tough construction for high-mileage abuse
description: A durable, lower-stack technical trail shoe with rock-plate protection for rugged ground.
skipIf: you want soft cushioning underfoot — this rides low, firm, and protective.

name: Traverse
benefits: Purpose-built for thru-hiking with rock plate and stable platform
Vibram Megagrip traction with a durable mesh upper
Quick-draining FKT insole for creek crossings and rain
description: A low-top hiker/trail-runner hybrid designed for thru-hikes and big-mile days under load.
skipIf: you mainly trail-run fast — it's tuned for hiking stability, not racing agility.

name: Pursuit 3
benefits: Zero drop with a real 28mm cushion stack for natural trail mechanics
Vibram Megagrip for superior traction on technical ground
Roomy toe box lets feet splay on long descents
description: A cushioned zero-drop trail runner for natural-form runners and hikers.
skipIf: you're new to zero drop — 0mm on trails demands adapted calves.

name: Trailventure 2 WP
benefits: eVent plant-based waterproof membrane keeps feet dry
Full-length ESS rock plate plus Vibram Megagrip for rugged terrain
Lightweight boot build with a roomy toe box
description: Topo's waterproof mid-height hiking boot for wet, technical trails and backpacking.
skipIf: you hike hot, dry trails — a waterproof boot runs warmer and heavier than you need.

name: Connect
benefits: Maximum ground feel — 10.5mm stack, droppable to 5.5mm without the insole
Vibram XS Trek EVO outsole grips all terrain
Award-winning pick for barefoot-style trail miles
description: Topo's minimalist zero-drop trail shoe for runners who want to feel the ground.
skipIf: you want any real cushioning — this is as close to barefoot as Topo gets.
